:::{#def-inner-product-linearity}
#### Linearity in the first slot

A function $\iprod{\cdot}{\cdot}$
that assigns a [real number](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers) to each ordered pair of vectors in $\reals^p$
has **linearity in the first slot** if

$$
\iprod{a\,\vx + b\,\vy}{\vecf{z}} = a\,\iprod{\vx}{\vecf{z}} + b\,\iprod{\vy}{\vecf{z}}
$$

[for all](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/proof-writing.html#def-universal-quantifier) $\vx, \vy, \vecf{z} \in \reals^p$ and all real numbers $a, b$.

:::
